method: Read-only archived principal workflow run/job metadata and streamed existing complete job logs; no downloads, builds, clones or raw copies. Metadata failed steps and selected exact diagnostic signatures are separate evidence axes. Counts include only enumerated observed run attempts/jobs, are non-exclusive, and do not establish a single root cause for all failed/cancelled workflows. Passing negative-test fixtures and generic words such as failed are not counted. Not exhaustive; unclassified jobs are explicit. Container migration is handled by alias resolution for gzip/xz/plain and decoded-text SHA provenance.
